what: As the photo frame enters from below and reaches the center, it opens downward from the top edge (clip inset bottom 100% → 0), and the photo inside sits at −30% above, then comes down into place with it — tied to scroll, sine.inOut. For work photos lined up like a timeline.

duration.Opening: Cell top edge at screen bottom → cell center at screen center

options.drop: Distance (%) the inner photo is initially offset, default -30
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.37,0,0.63,1”, default sine.inOut
options.lag: Seconds the scroll is followed late (scrub count), default 0 (immediate) — Brand golden string 2 (phone 4)
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo (child) that drops down within the cell. Defaults to first child

from.where: index.html .e-tl (needle timeline) work photos — original [data-timeline-item-reveal] clip inset(0 0 100% 0)→0 + first child yPercent -30→0 sine.inOut, trigger row top bottom → center center scrub true

index.html .kw-melody (tall golden string bundle in the center of the screen) — original .js-melody mask-size 100% 0 → 100% 100% (from the top, a solid-color mask so it equals clip inset bottom 100%→0), ease linear, top center → bottom center, scrub 2 (phone 4) — drop: 0; ease: none; start: top center; end: bottom center; lag: 2
